      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F9" sourceRef="S_Merge" targetRef="S_Deposit" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F10" sourceRef="S_Deposit" targetRef="S_EndPaid" />
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="S_F11" sourceRef="S_Reject" targetRef="S_EndRejected" />
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Bd_7" name="7 days" cancelActivity="false" attachedToRef="Sub_Process">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDuration>P7D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Bd_30" name="30 days" attachedToRef="Sub_Process">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition><bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Progress" name="Send approval in progress email" />
